tools.name: run_audit
tools.description:
Audit a public website for search, AI-crawler and AI-agent readiness.

    Only audit sites the user owns or is allowed to check (our terms require it). If it's unclear whose site it is, ask first.
    url: the site's homepage, e.g. https://example.com
    profiles: optional site types that add chec

tools.name: get_findings
tools.description: Return the result of an audit or re-check you started: progress if it is still running, the findings when complete.

tools.name: recheck
tools.description:
Re-run a previous audit (same site and profiles) and return only the checks whose status changed. Paid plans.
    Like run_audit, it may return status "running": then call get_findings with the new run_id.

tools.name: get_fix_pack
tools.description:
Builder-specific, copy-paste fix pack for a run's failures. builder: emergent, lovable, nextjs or generic. Paid plans.
    Returns fix_pack text plus fill_in: values only the site owner knows. Ask the user for them and substitute [[NAME]] before handing the pack over.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Download link for the evidence workbook (every check, every URL, raw evidence). Paid plans.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: Explain the site-type profiles that add checks to an audit.
